name: PIN-UP
source:
Three girls live in a house with the main character. They were captured separately, but remain in the house by their own will. They walk in underwear all days long provoking main character to inventively use lots of items scattered around the house to insult them. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-may-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
三个女孩与主人公同住在一间屋子里。她们原本是分别被抓来的，如今却自愿留在这里。她们整天穿着内衣四处走动，挑逗主人公，让他发挥创意，利用屋内散落的各种物品羞辱她们。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-may-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
